component.name: OpenZap
component.summary: Watch IPTV playlists with a programme guide

description.p: OpenZap plays IPTV channels from an M3U playlist, with an XMLTV programme guide. Playlists and guides can be local files or URLs.

ul.li: Channel list with search, groups, favorites and logos
What is on now and next, and the full guide of each channel
Audio track and subtitle switching, picture size, always on top
Downloaded playlists and guides are kept, so the app starts fast and works when a server is down

description.p: OpenZap does not come with any channels: you need a playlist.

screenshot.caption: A playlist with its programme guide, dark theme

description.p: Moving through the channel list to its last channels no longer makes the list flicker and jump. A proxy that cannot be reached or rejects the login is now named in the error instead of a general network error. New command-line options --position and --size open the window at a given place and size.

Proxy support (Settings → Network): HTTP and SOCKS proxies for playlists, guides and logos; streams go through HTTP proxies. Holding a key or the D-pad to switch channels no longer opens every channel on the way, only the one where it stops.

Gamepad support: the D-pad and stick move through the channel list and the guide, A and B confirm and go back, the bumpers switch channels, the triggers change the volume, View and Menu together quit. Works on the Steam Deck in Game Mode.
In the Steam Deck's Game Mode, Browse… opens a built-in file browser that works with touch and the arrow keys.
A quit button and Ctrl+Q, for the Steam Deck's Game Mode which has no window close button. System mixers show the channel name.
Sound that the system mixer muted is detected and comes back with M. Text and controls can be made larger (interface scale, Ctrl +/-).
The settings fit small screens such as the Steam Deck. A reminder over the video tells why a channel is silent (muted, volume 0).
Everything works from the keyboard, also in fullscreen: the arrow keys and Enter move through the channel list, the groups and the programme guide.

Archive (catch-up) and timeshift: watch past programmes from the guide, pause, rewind and go back to live on channels whose provider keeps an archive. A time shift per channel for guides that run ahead or behind.
Switching the audio track no longer leaves live channels silent; the next channel starts with its own default tracks.
Clear the cache from the settings, the I key shows the whole programme description, picture size per channel.
First Flatpak release, with its own libmpv: runs on any distribution and on the Steam Deck.
